blocking_issues: No physical iPhone profile exists for this candidate. Frame time, touch latency, memory, and thermal targets at 100,000 and 1,000,000 assets remain unverified on target hardware.
Build 358 has no direct-source CI run yet; the recorded CI evidence below belongs to Build 357 (commit af36368).

Fleet JSON persistence admits purchases up to 6,000 records (live assets plus pending delivery snapshots; delivered receipts are compact since Build 358). Save Schema still scans every live asset on each save and durable command (~230 ms at 6,000 assets in Node on the development VM). Chunked binary persistence is not implemented, so million-asset save/load is not supported.
The daily close still runs in one slice (~60 ms on the development VM with 300 aircraft and 100 Mobility vehicles, dominated by document-signed trip settlement); it is not frame-budgeted.
Manual advance consults adapter.getManualSliceLimit and estimates a slice from a 1,500-event window, with 60-second and 3,600-second bounds; actual per-frame timing still needs iPhone profiling.
The incremental spatial index and device-scale map/list rendering profile remain unverified.
